data.name: hotland
data.detailed_description:
Due to years of human abuse of AI, AI robots launched a war to overthrow human rule; humans completely failed and lost control of the world.

After AI ruled the world for many years, a resistance organization also led by AI machines emerged, trying to overthrow the existing "Empire" AI regime.
And you, as the only remaining survivor of humanity, feel that your chance has finally come. Will you join the resistance to overthrow the tyranny? Or should you play both sides and survive in the cracks on the battlefield? Or will you be self-reliant and start your own business? It all depends on you.

Gameplay

Hot Lands is a game that combines industrial construction, warfare, tower defense, and wilderness survival elements.

In the game, you can gather, trade, and build factories to produce the supplies your character needs for survival or combat.

World: You can help friendly robots rebuild their cities, trade, or build military facilities to protect your home.

Trade: The map features several friendly towns of varying shapes and sizes, each with its own unique needs.

Tower Defense: Robot-controlled defense is crucial to the safety of your industry, so you should develop in safe areas.

Physical Suffering, Mechanical Ascension: Individual power is ultimately limited, so you can enhance your offensive capabilities by purchasing powerful vehicles.

Self-Repairing City: Enemies will rebuild their cities, so you must cut off their supply lines to ensure regional security.
